Players Committee card image of [[Darksaber]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on Gideon, [Set 13] Maul, or your Mandalorian. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character. Draw destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 > defense value. If just lost from table or hand, opponent may steal this weapon into hand.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/darksaber.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/darksaber.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
